feeds.description: My name is Soula and I live in Australia. I literally fell into the land of chronic pelvic pain - specifically Pudendal Neuralgia (PN), on March 1, 2007 when a fitball I was sitting on burst and I fell to a concrete floor. I created pudendalnerve.com.au in 2011 to avoid others the experience of misdiagnosis and to form a helpful resource. I wanted people to know that what they were feeling wasn't forever and that they could change get help and change their situation.
